title: Sufficiently Size Me
description: Sufficiently Size Me — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle off Level 7 of MutantMania. Smash Babyface Buster and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Track Down Logan the Liger

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle off Level 7 of MutantMania. Smash Babyface Buster and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Friend, you haven't been pulling in the crowds like you used to. Unfortunately, it's a sad fact of the life of a professional MutantMania fighter that smaller crowds dictate smaller opponents...literally. Go to...Ah say, go to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle off Level 7 of MutantMania and look for Babyface Buster. You'll see what Ah mean.

Turn-in:

So how did you find Babyface Buster? No, seriously, how *did* you find him? That plucky fellow is so wee, Ah'm always afraid Ah'm going to step on him accidently.

Objectives:

  • Smash Babyface Buster

Level range: 86–100
